name: single-mcp-endpoint
assertion: All three HTTP methods (POST, GET, DELETE) point to the same /mcp endpoint path

name: session-id-from-header
assertion: Session ID is read from req.headers['mcp-session-id'], NOT from query params

name: uses-register-tool
assertion: Tools are registered via server.registerTool(), NOT the deprecated server.tool()

name: input-schema-is-raw-shape
assertion: inputSchema is a plain object of Zod fields like { slug: z.string() }, NOT wrapped in z.object()

name: no-stdout-logging
assertion: No console.log() calls exist — all logging uses console.error() (stderr only)

name: server-per-session
assertion: A new McpServer instance is created per session, not shared globally

name: capabilities-declared
assertion: Server advertises tools, resources, and/or prompts capabilities in the initialize response

name: initialize-check
assertion: POST handler checks for req.body.method === 'initialize' when no session ID is present
